name: intro
title: Jev needs Jeeves.
voice: Jev needs Jeeves. So does your to-do list. Here's how they work together.

name: 01-workflow
title: Give the work a shape.
voice: Start with a request. Each agent gets a clear job, and you can see every step. This run uses Jev and Codex.

name: 02-decision
title: Jev makes the judgment.
voice: Jev spots an outage and chooses the urgent route. Open the decision to see its answer, confidence, and the path it picked.

name: 03-waiting
title: A mystery deserves a question.
voice: Now try a request that's missing the details. Jeeves asks a question, saves the run, and waits. No answer, no next step.

name: 04-answer
title: Your answer moves things along.
voice: Add what's missing and hit submit. The next agent can now get to work.

name: 05-result
title: Useful work. Ready for review.
voice: Here's the result: a concrete action brief, a suggested fix, and a draft reply. It's ready for your review. Nothing has been sent.

name: 06-export
title: Keep the process. Take it with you.
voice: Save the workflow for next time, or export it as a portable skill. Next Tuesday is already looking a little more organised.

name: outro
title: A little direction.
voice: Jev makes the judgment. Jeeves keeps things moving. Open source, on your desktop. Very good, then.
